data.value: Will the Herrera bakery's part-time bookkeeper file the quarterly payroll return before the revenue service's month-end deadline, as she has for the last seven quarters?

The Herrera bakery operates in a jurisdiction where quarterly payroll returns must be filed by the end of the month. The current quarter's return is due by 2026-10-31. The bookkeeper has access to the bakery's payroll records and the filing system. The owner and bookkeeper have a standard working relationship; the owner does not typically check on the filing unless reminded.
